environment.competingLoad: Independent user LCD tasks may remain active; GPU benchmark is exclusive only among the M5 team, not machine-wide.

scenario.page: Actual production DOMStage with six independently attached Family H fields; real shared scheduler with scroll-driven uniforms.
scenario.deadline: Actual quality reduction, >=5 completed GPU workloads after downshift, ongoing rendering, and no >1-second cadence/completion stall during timed capture; cold stalls reported separately.
scenario.cpuBoundary: First field custom onBeforeFrame hook to shared queue completion; earlier automatic hooks on that first field are excluded. Capture is asynchronous and does not serialize rAF.
scenario.css: Public production bindCSSParameters; 0/1/8 selected bindings, 30 warmup +120 manually sampled visible frame hooks, no GPU rendering in timing region.

results.proxy: SwiftShader software adapter with the same six Family H hosts, initial params/pixels and real scroll driver as native gates; a software pressure proxy, not physical weaker-device validation.

coldStartup.clock: Node wall time from navigation start, including browser protocol/readiness checks
coldStartup.limit: The capture duration does not include cold readiness or the initial queue drain; those durations are retained here, and are not evidence of stall-free startup.
